title: The Less the Merrier? Investigating Language Representation in Multilingual Models
benchmark_measurement: Language correctness and coherence of text generation when prompted with Bible verses, particularly to test low-resource language performance.
findings: When prompted in English with a Bible verse, GPT-3 sometimes generated only the verse citation (e.g., '(John 3:16)'), which was then misidentified as German by a language detection tool. This highlights a failure mode in generation for religious prompts, used here as a proxy for a type of text common in low-resource language datasets.
